verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel says it offers end-to-end support from temporary nonimmigrant visas through to permanent residency. Its immigrant-visas page points to a PDF of the 'most common routes to permanent residency', so a green-card continuation after a work visa is part of its documented scope. Nothing in the pack names EB-1A or EB-2 NIW, or describes a strategy for moving from an O-1 to a green card. missing for 10: explicit EB-1A/EB-2 NIW documentation, O-1-to-green-card strategy content, founder-specific self-petition guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: From temporary nonimmigrant visas to permanent residency (green cards).
